protocol.fixed_V0: Each reduced isotherm normalized to its own source V0, then matched to DAC V/V0; reference normalization assumption explicit
protocol.DAC: Published ultrasonic-constrained Vinet branches; Au corrected2007; Co184 baseline
protocol.RSW: Recovered room-temperature data refit to fixed-K0 Vinet in stated ranges; Al adopted preliminary pair; Pt Holmes exact analytic curve
protocol.source_refit_objective: Unweighted squared pressure residuals; no missing pointwise errors invented
protocol.analytic_sampling: 321 uniform pressure points over0-160GPa for Wang/Holmes; convergence checked at1601
protocol.final_averaging: Arithmetic mean of ten pressures at identical DAC volumes and a common P2004 coordinate; equal total weight per metal
protocol.ruby_objective: Unweighted squared pressure residual of ruby power law relative to that mean on321 uniform P2004 points
protocol.coverage: All-ten numerical extension to160GPa requires continuation of Co DAC above65.2, Mo/Ag above97.9, Pt/Ta/Au above93.6; Ni source table ends120GPa
protocol.temperatures: Handbook298.15K, Hixson293K baseline/300K alternative, Wang/Holmes300K; no unreported temperature conversion
protocol.fit_uncertainty: No statistical interval on A/B; source model errors, shared ancestors and covariance unavailable

limitations: Exact author objective, grid and weights remain undocumented
Co full-table alternative is a declared range change, not a proven author selection
Pt literal2004 table is preserved, not corrected to agree with graph
Corrected Au observations unavailable; corrected source EOS used
Al preliminary shock reduction not independently replayed
Original shock-to-isotherm reductions not rerun from incomplete thermal/electronic inputs
No new pressure standard or catalogue replacement
